newsitem.title: UK: Wet Brent moves at firmer August -19 cts - trade.
newsitem.headline: Wet Brent moves at firmer August -19 cts - trade.

text.p: A cargo of Brent Blend crude moved at a sharply firmer August Brent -19 cents on Monday, traders said.
The value of the July 5-7 loader was well above a Brent June 26-28 stem moved at August Brent -60 cents on Tuesday last week.
A Forties loading July 9-11 was also heard changing hands on Monday but no details were immediately available.
Traders attributed the strong Brent to a strong show of buying interest from a multitude of shorts. Business in other North Sea grades was described as quiet.
The seller of the July 5-7 Brent obtained it on Friday but the level paid was no immediately known.
